title: Sign-off Record
description: A sign-off record states that a person signed a milestone off against one code tree, and lists what the sign-off left open. One record per file, spec/extras/signoff/so-<milestone>-<NNNN>.json, written by 'specdev milestone sign-off' and never by hand. The file holds a records array of exactly one record, and the file name without .json is the record id. The close of the milestone refuses without one.

records.description: The one sign-off record of this file.

items.description: A sign-off record: who signed which milestone off, at which code tree, and what was listed as open at that moment.

signoff_id.description: Id of this record: so-, the id of the milestone and a number of at least four digits. Equals the file name without .json. Example: so-ms-account-recovery-0001.

about.description: The one Step 14 roadmap milestone this sign-off is about, as a one-item array.

tree.description: Id of the code tree the person signed off (a git tree id).

git_author.description: The git author of the person who signed off: name and email as git reports them.

recorded_at.description: UTC time the tool wrote the record, ISO 8601. Informational: nothing compares it.

listed.description: What was open when the person signed off, as the tool counted it: the sign-off shows these to the person and records them. Counts are whole numbers; the lists hold node ids.

manual_fixtures.description: Number of manual fixtures of the milestone.

attested.description: Number of those that carry an attestation.

deferred_tasks.description: Ids of the tasks of the milestone that are deferred.

wont_do_tasks.description: Ids of the tasks of the milestone that will not be done.

open_items.description: Number of plan items that are not executed.

staging_prod_proof_owed.description: Ids of the nodes whose proof is owed at staging or prod.
